items.difficulty_reason: Base change for higher direct images along a flat square: the presheaf-level isomorphism is imported from lemma-base-change, the total-direct-image base change map exists because g and g' are flat (Cohomology on Sites base-change-map section), and it is shown to be a quasi-isomorphism by writing the slice 2-fibre product equality for an object y' over V and concluding with lemma-pushforward-restriction. Retained author proof at lines 4167-4185.
